page_title: LEC 1-1 EMP | Lecce v Empoli 08/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' A dangerous looking corner kick from Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is cleared to safety by the defence.

90+4' This shall not pass! Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+3' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli).
90+2' Half-chance! Antonino Gallo (Lecce) plays a pass into the box, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post.

89' Great solo effort by Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone is alert and denies him.
87' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
86' Corner kick. Lecce will have an opportunity.
85' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His rocket of a shot crashes against the crossbar! What a shot.
84' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
84' Liam Henderson (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
84' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
82' Ante Rebic (Lecce) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
82' The foul by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) was seen by Juan Luca Sacchi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
81' The game is interrupted now, Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Liberato Cacace walks off the pitch to be replaced by Junior Sambia (Empoli).
80' A substitution has been made. Youssef Maleh is replaced by Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli).
78' Luca Gotti decides to make a substitution. Frederic Guilbert will be replaced by Ante Rebic (Lecce).

77' 1 - 1 Antonino Gallo showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 1:1.
76' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

74' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
73' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.
73' Wonderful movement by Lecce. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
71' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
69' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) is penalised for holding. Juan Luca Sacchi signals a set piece.
68' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post.
68' Pietro Pellegri goes off the pitch and Ola Solbakken (Empoli) comes on.
67' A cross from a corner kick by Lecce is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
67' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Lecce force a corner. They send men into the box.
65' Lecce are ruled offside.

65' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) produces an accurate shot from the free kick. His promising effort flies towards the bottom left corner, but is blocked by Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who makes a fine save to keep the ball from hitting the net.

64' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Luca Sacchi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Lecce earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
61' Saba Goglichidze is substituted due to injury. Roberto D'Aversa gives a chance to Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli).
60' That's the end of the game for Remi Oudin, who is replaced by Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce).
60' A substitution has been made. Ylber Ramadani goes off and Nicola Sansone (Lecce) comes on.
60' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' The resulting corner from Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is cleared.
59' Half-chance! Youssef Maleh (Empoli) plays a pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts well to snuff out the attack. Empoli win a corner.

57' What a sweet touch by Liberato Cacace (Empoli) after latching on to a fine pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and unleashes a cannonball close to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper makes a brilliant save, pushing the ball onto the post. Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!

56' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
55' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

55' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Lecce will take a corner kick.
54' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
52' Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) is cautioned by the referee.
51' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
50' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.

49' Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
48' A player from Empoli commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
46' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce), who plants a header just wide of the right post from close range.
45+1' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Liberato Cacace (Empoli) for his blatant foul.
45+1' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach comes off his line to gather the ball.
41' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
39' Liam Henderson (Empoli) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
38' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) brings his opponent down. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
37' Lecce control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

33' 0 - 1 Goal! Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Wladimiro Falcone had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.

32' Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
31' Corner kick. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is ready to send the ball into the box.

31' Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Empoli will take a corner.
27' Remi Oudin (Lecce) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
27' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Lecce have been awarded a free kick.
25' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Luca Sacchi who sees an offensive foul.
24' Empoli concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
22' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' Luca Gotti is forced to make a change. Lameck Banda (Lecce) is unable to continue due to injury, Santiago Pierotti comes on.
18' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
17' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Lameck Banda (Lecce), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
16' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli). It's a free kick to Lecce, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
15' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
13' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Youssef Maleh (Empoli).
11' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) has time in the box after a cross from Lameck Banda, but places his shot high over the bar.
8' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
7' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul after Liam Henderson (Empoli) hacks down one of his opponents.
7' Empoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
5' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
4' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
3' Good clearance! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
1' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
1' The first half has started.
Lecce will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Juan Luca Sacchi.
